blocks.task_summary: Write down an expression for (g ∘ f)(x) where f(x) = x − 3 and g(x) = x² + k².
method_path: Form composite function g(f(x)) by substituting f(x) into g
Simplify to (x − 3)² + k² or expand to x² − 6x + 9 + k²

evidence.basis: M1: attempt to form (g ∘ f)(x); A1: (g ∘ f)(x) = (x − 3)² + k² = x² − 6x + 9 + k²

blocks.task_summary: Given (g ∘ f)(2) = 10, find the possible values of k.
method_path: Substitute x = 2 into (g ∘ f)(x) and set equal to 10
Take square root to get k = ±3
accepted_alternatives: Using expanded form: substitute x = 2 into x² − 6x + 9 + k² = 10 to obtain 4 − 12 + 9 + k² = 10, giving k² = 9, k = ±3

evidence.basis: M1: substituting x = 2 into their (g ∘ f)(x) and setting their expression = 10; (A1): k² = 9; A1: k = ±3
